name: ClickUp
label: ClickUp API v2
description: ClickUp API v2 via OfficialApiNode (nodes/clickup/api_spec.json). Official ClickUp API v2. Personal tokens go in Authorization as the raw token (no Bearer prefix). Token scopes follow the workspace admin grant. Official docs: https://developer.clickup.com/reference/gettasks. OUTPUT is {status, http_status, data} or {error}. Secrets never appear on OUTPUT.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One ClickUp official API call. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Set operation plus the path/query/body fields that operation lists in api_spec.json. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"task_create"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official HTTP verb to run. Overrides instance operation when non-blank. EXACT accepted values: 'task_create', 'task_get', 'task_list', 'task_update', 'task_delete', 'task_members', 'task_custom_field', 'list_create', 'list_get', 'list_list', 'list_update', 'list_delete', 'folder_create', 'folder_get', 'folder_update', 'folder_delete', 'comment_create', 'comment_get', 'comment_update', 'comment_delete', 'checklist_create', 'checklist_delete', 'checklist_item_create', 'checklist_item_update', 'goal_create', 'goal_get', 'goal_update', 'goal_delete', 'key_result_create', 'key_result_delete', 'tag_add', 'tag_remove', 'dependency_create', 'dependency_delete', 'time_entry_create', 'time_entry_get', 'time_entry_update', 'time_entry_delete', 'time_start', 'time_stop', 'listen'. listen/trigger/webhook_listen never open a socket — they return an error telling you to use a BPMN message event. Example: 'task_create'.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Handler result object. Success: status='ok', http_status, data (parsed JSON). Example: {"status":"ok","http_status":200,"data":{}}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Present on HTTP 2xx. EXACT value: 'ok'. Example: 'ok'.

schema.label: HTTP status
schema.description: Provider HTTP status code. Example: 200.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the official API, or the raw string when not JSON. Example: {}.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default official API call for this instance when input.operation is blank. EXACT accepted values: task_create, task_get, task_list, task_update, task_delete, task_members, task_custom_field, list_create, list_get, list_list, list_update, list_delete, folder_create, folder_get, folder_update, folder_delete, comment_create, comment_get, comment_update, comment_delete, checklist_create, checklist_delete, checklist_item_create, checklist_item_update, goal_create, goal_get, goal_update, goal_delete, key_result_create, key_result_delete, tag_add, tag_remove, dependency_create, dependency_delete, time_entry_create, time_entry_get, time_entry_update, time_entry_delete, time_start, time_stop, listen. Default: task_create. Example: task_create.

configurationParameters.label: Api Token
configurationParameters.description: Provider credential for auth.type=header (configKey api_token). REQUIRED secret — StudioQuack secret binding only; never put this on INPUT. Never logged. Example: 'redacted-token'.

configurationParameters.label: Team Id
configurationParameters.description: Default workspace (team) id for goal_create and time_entry_* / time_start / time_stop when INPUT team_id is blank. Example: '123456'.

configurationParameters.label: Owners
configurationParameters.description: goal_create owners (array of user ids). Example: [123].

configurationParameters.label: Type
configurationParameters.description: key_result_create type. Example: number | currency | boolean | percentage.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout for the official HTTPS call. Positive integer. Blank/0/negative → 25. Example: 25.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.
